description.p: Whatevr is a native Linux WhatsApp client backed by the whatevrd background daemon.

p.em: gRPC is dead. Long live the daemon!

description.p: After almost 2 months of work, Whatevr finally has the architecture I wanted from the start.
New stuff:

ul.li: whatkevr now talks to whatevrd over a stable, documented local protocol. One daemon, one socket, and as many frontends as you want.
Two tiny example frontends now ship with the project, including a working WhatsApp client in about 30 lines of shell.
Phone-side chat deletions and read state now sync properly, and Whatevr can ask the phone for older history.
You can edit your profile about, block contacts, open downloaded photos in the viewer, and see useful tombstones for unsupported media.
Added a setting to snap back to the newest message after sending.

description.p: Fixed stuff:

ul.li: Chats open much faster, the chat list loads lazily, and navigation and column slides are considerably smoother.
Unread counts can actually be cleared now, unread dividers land where they should, and new-message badges no longer count your own sends.
Starred messages, search results, reply quotes, and other message jumps now go to the correct message instead of vaguely opening the chat.
Fixed animated stickers turning into blocky garbage after the first frame.
Fixed custom wallpapers appearing squashed or missing while opening a chat.
Fixed encrypted message edits, changed contact identities, stalled history syncs, and several "waiting for this message" cases.
Lots of protocol hardening, ordering fixes, UI polish and regression tests.

description.p: Upgrade note:
The systemd socket moved in this release. If you use the systemd user units, run:

p.code: systemctl --user daemon-reload systemctl --user try-restart whatevrd.socket whatevrd.service See ya! I am going to stare at something that is not a socket now.

search settings won't activate first option and show weird states now

description.p: See ya next time! (no one is reading these)
New stuff:

ul.li: Closing a chat with non-empty composer will leave it as a draft
You can edit sent message and received messages will be edited (no more fun)
Messages can be pinned and they show up on top of the chat
You can star/unstar and see starred messages (global and chat-wise)
Archived chats
Mute chats
Search (wow), you can search contacts and messages and both
There is a quick side bar with home, groups, DMs and Starred messages, settings and profile buttons
Wait whaaaaa!! SETTINGS!!! HELL YEAHH!!! BASIC FEATURES IN 2026!

description.p: Fixed stuff:

ul.li: Read more now shows a dialog box instead of changing the chat geometry
Clear composer after sending media
Clicks were leaking through avatar in contact info
smol fixes and perf improvements

description.p: I react to Context Menus Again lots of stuff
New stuff:

ul.li: You can now right click on messages to see a context menu, showing various actions like forward, delete, copy (text, as markdown, image, links), select, message delivery info
You can select multiple message and do grouped actions on them
Messages can now receive reactions and user can send reactions and view them
Opening an unread message will open it at the starting of the last read message
If chat receives a message it will only be marked read when user scrolls down to it
Chat list now shows when somebody is typing

description.p: Fixed stuff:

ul.li: Favourited sticker from other devices will now automatically show up in favourites
Accent color won't dull now for lots of elements when unfocusing the window
Fixed a bug where small chats where being stuck to the top instead of bottom
Lots of small fixes

description.p: Lots of optimizations as well as new features
New stuff:

ul.li: You can send stickers now, fully featured sticker pane
Scrolling is now smoother and more kinetic, should feel natural
Emojis in recent tab will update their positions after its closed
You can press escape at various places to close various panes (panes, replies, chats)
Inline Emoji Selector: you can use Discord-like syntax :sobs to search for emojis in the composer

description.p: Fixed stuff:

ul.li: Fixed a bug with stale sockets causing UI to show incorrect daemon state
Fixed scroll bar being stuck after scrolling a few pixels
Fixed same seconds messages having wrong ordering sometimes
Improved UI performance and history sync performance
